entities.summary: Gottlieb Friedrich Bach (b. 1714-09-10, Meiningen) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Meiningen and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
